ai_summary: Aarvi Encon Limited will host a video conference investor meet on September 23, 2026, where its Key Managerial Personnel will engage with a group of investors to discuss publicly available information about the company and industry. This proactive investor relations initiative, a routine regulatory disclosure, aims to clarify existing data, with the company explicitly stating no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared, thus mitigating potential selective disclosure concerns.
